special_session_note: Conservative stop at15:15 before CAS; no CAS/postclose fills. Explicit validity window; unverified future calendars fail closed.
worker_supervision_note: Idle heartbeat budget stays worker_stale_seconds. A cycle in progress refreshes its polling heartbeat every worker_heartbeat_interval_seconds up to worker_cycle_max_seconds; polling may then age worker_polling_stale_seconds (12-symbol depth batch ~15s + two 65s rate-limit backoffs + ~90s worst observed post-quote work + pnl). After signalling a stale worker the supervisor waits up to worker_stop_wait_seconds for the lease and starts the replacement in the same call. A guardian whose own checks were more than guardian_gap_grace_seconds apart defers killing for one check.
completed_bar_cutoff_note: A session's daily bar counts as completed (for scans, EOD and weekly expected sessions) only at or after this IST time.

indicator_excluded_sessions.2026-11-08: Muhurat special session: explicit calendar entry (freeze plan A9); excluded from Stage 1 (prefilter), indicators, entry/exit conditions and the ADV window. Still listed in special_sessions for live trading hours.

strategy_07_trail_source: Copied from strategy_rules.json 7.trailing_update ('next-session stop=.9*H'); engine refuses to start if the two disagree.
strategy_07_stop_fill_source: Copied from strategy_rules.json 7.execution_priority (trail_gap at the open, else trail_touch at the fixed prior-close stop). Close-only exits were measured on the 7 Nov 2026 research history and not adopted; the engine refuses to start if this token disagrees with the frozen rule.

db_helper.note: Worker-only persistent Turso connection for query/batch (db_helper.mjs). Reads retry on transient/helper failures then fall back to per-call db.mjs; writes are re-sent only when they never reached Turso. enabled=false restores the per-call path everywhere.

market_data.quotes_fallback_note: Primary path is one /data/quotes request per cycle (chunked at quotes_max_symbols_per_request). Freshness uses exchange ltt when present and never midnight tt. If ltt is absent during a verified open session, quote_at is the response time (FYERS documented quotes fields have no ltt, only tt). Depth is used only when official open or auction price is missing. A shared per-second/minute/day budget (headroom vs the Standard plan) is enforced and logged; history sync cannot spend the session-monitor reserve.
market_data.fyers_limits_note: Standard Data APIs from 16 Oct 2026: 5/sec, 50/min, 5000/day. Exceeding the per-minute limit more than 3 times in a day blocks the user for the rest of the day. Depth is one symbol per request. Quotes allow 50 symbols per request on Standard.

reference_feeds.fetch_note: NSE refuses non-browser user agents and refuses whole sessions at random (403). Each refused session is replaced after exponential backoff (backoff_seconds doubling, capped at backoff_max_seconds) for up to max_attempts; HTML pages are never parsed as data. ASM and GSM fall back to the nsearchives CSVs only when every listed file loads. Corporate actions fall back first to the same range API fetched with curl --http2 and a cookie warmup, then to the Bc*.csv corporate-action file inside the latest completed-session NSE PR zip on nsearchives; a failure never deletes retained rows. The reference-feed refresh uses reference_feeds.lock, not engine.lock.

runtime_deps.note: Box VM forks rematerialize /workspace without gitignored runtime dirs (.venv, node_modules). run.sh and preflight restore paper-trading and extra_node_projects from pinned lockfiles; npm ci on adaptive-live is skipped while state/adaptive.lock is held. Install/rollback scripts must never touch those dirs.

history_sync_scan_max_requests_note: Morning scan --sync only fills bars still missing after the evening sync-history job, capped so the 08:45 screen stays under 8 minutes (40 requests at the 40/min Fyers budget is about one minute). Evening sync-history uses the shared Fyers day budget and cannot spend the session-monitor reserve.

official_close.note: EOD overlay only when live marks are stale. Never invents prices; incomplete or missing bhavcopy leaves daily P&L unavailable. Does not mutate paper_positions.mark_price.
